This issue is being closed because it doesn't contain enough verifiable detail for us to act on.

{{SUMMARY}}

Reports need to reference code, APIs, and behavior that exist in Medusa, along with your Medusa version and steps to reproduce. Using AI tools to help write a report is fine, but the details have to come from your own setup. If you're running into a real problem, comment here with a minimal reproduction in your own words (Medusa version, steps, and the actual error output) so a maintainer can reopen it.
